name: biome
description: biome.base.json (shared rules) + biome.json (per-app overrides) + lint/format scripts
postInstall: Remove devDeps: eslint, typescript-eslint, @eslint/js, eslint-plugin-*, prettier
Put per-app exceptions in biome.json's `overrides` — never edit biome.base.json, it is centrally managed and `update` overwrites it
Run: bunx @biomejs/biome check --write . && bun run lint
